name: Fish Left Over
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: hot stewed tomatoes
ingredients.originalText: one cup of hot stewed tomatoes

ingredients.name: one-quarter cup of fine cracker crumbs

instructions.text: Cook minced onion in butter until yellow
Add flour and when well mixed and bubbling, stir it into a cup of hot stewed tomatoes
When it has cooked a little and is thick, season to taste
Take one part each of cold boiled fish and macaroni with one-quarter cup of cheese

Strain the tomato sauce over them and one-quarter cup of fine cracker crumbs, moistened in one-third cup of melted butter on the top

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cook minced onion in butter until yellow
2. Add flour and when well mixed and bubbling, stir it into a cup of hot stewed tomatoes
3. When it has cooked a little and is thick, season to taste
4. Take one part each of cold boiled fish and macaroni with one-quarter cup of cheese
5. Cut into small bits one cold egg
6. Strain the tomato sauce over them and one-quarter cup of fine cracker crumbs, moistened in one-third cup of melted butter on the top
7. Bake till brown
